name: activity-log
description: Unified activity tracker across local Git, GitLab and Jira
author: Teodora Zaharinova <teodora.zaharinova@inform-software.com>

scripts.dashboard:build: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir dashboard run build
scripts.dashboard:build:prod: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir dashboard exec ng build --configuration production
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir desktop exec tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm --dir desktop exec tauri build
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run api:dev" "pnpm run dashboard:dev" --names api,ng --prefix-colors cyan,blue
scripts.verify: pnpm run types:generate && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run rust:check && pnpm run rust:clippy && pnpm run rust:test && pnpm run dashboard:typecheck && pnpm run dashboard:build
